production_API.identity: ARM64 MH_FILESET, uniquecom.apple.kernel, bounded embedded MH_EXECUTE, expected CPU/subtype/member flags/UUID/kernel-entry VM. First embedded __TEXT must bind header+commands through outer VM mapping.
production_API.code_profile: Exact __TEXT_EXEC VM/protection/flag/size and all target-section metadata, entire segment SHA84b49e13 and __text SHA8db2a1ba. Named standalone-function ABI fact inherited through complete same-VA code equality; no symbol grep or occurrence count.
production_API.offset_contract: Kernel segment/section file offsets are absolute KC offsets. Each consumed whole range uniquely resolves through outer VM->file mapping; sections also match segment fileoff+VM delta. No member base added. Golden unmapped blob, partial coverage, ambiguous outer section shadow and double-offset forms refuse.
production_API.relocation: Coherent file-only relocation may pass if all source-proven kernel VM/UUID/layout/code bytes match; resulting whole-image SHA differs and must be freshly bound by future caller. This does not transfer historical af9 packet admission.
production_API.test_boundary: _verify(raw,profile) is private test/internal injection only, not a production profile-selection API or security sandbox against hostile Python.
